svg.text: EXERCISE 4 / VARIANT 14 / THREADED CONNECTION DIAGRAM F
Diagram F: upper clearance hole / lower blind tapped hole.
Components 3 + 11: cylindrical-head bolt and spring washer.
Selected: M12 × 28 under-head length; washer 2.4 thick.
Threaded hole: full thread22; drillØ10.2 to25 + drill point.
Bolt end20 mm below joint; full thread reserve2 mm.
HeadØ18 ×12; socket10 A/F. Dimensions are actual mm.
